evidence: Checks whether incoming x1 equals 16, loads a pointer from input+0xce0, and requires it nonnull. It passes that pointer plus a stack output slot to f_700183b3c0 and requires result bit 0; then reads a 32-bit value at the returned object+0x70, transforms it with the visible mask/sign-extension sequence and passes it to f_700185c420. Finally it calls the accepted place_player_on_waivers helper with the same entry pointer in x1 and constants 2 and 3 in x2/x3, then returns 2; failed gates return 1. decompiled/main/main_0088.c:31671-31698. No indexed caller is available.

Queries accepted attribute_context_status_value_get first with selector 2 and then selector 1. For each status, passes the value and an output slot to f_700181acf0 with the global table rooted at 0x7004650760; if the lookup returns a set low bit, it passes the retrieved pointer to f_70007539f0. The lookup helper bounds-checks the selector against the table count and computes an indexed 0x550-byte entry before storing the selected pointer to the output slot. This target returns zero. decompiled/main/main_0058.c:18180-18213; lookup helper decompiled/main/main_0169.c:28801-28823. No indexed caller is available.

Reads a context pointer through f_70008dc780, which loads the pointer from global root 0x7003abf000+0xa98 then dereferences +0x198 (decompiled/main/main_0064.c:39745-39753). It returns zero for a null pointer or if the pointed object’s uint32 at +0xc0 is zero or differs from 2. With value 2, it queries accepted attribute_context_status_value_get for selector 0x13 and returns 1 unless the low byte is 7, in which case it returns 0. decompiled/main/main_0105.c:46745-46771. No indexed caller is available.

Initializes the caller’s uint32 output to UINT32_MAX and queries accepted attribute_context_status_value_get for selector 0x13. Only when the low byte is 4 does it load the global pointer at 0x7003b02000+0x630 through f_7000dcfcd4 (decompiled/main/main_0093.c:50716-50723); if nonnull it calls f_7000dd9a00, whose body returns a boolean derived from the low bit written by f_700043b2d8, and stores that result to the output when it is at most 2 (decompiled/main/main_0094.c:8433-8449). Otherwise the output remains UINT32_MAX. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:34310-34335. No indexed caller is available.

Calls f_70006ef4a0 with a local output slot; the helper reads the qword at global address 0x7003a89000+0x5b8, stores it to the slot, and returns whether that value is nonzero (decompiled/main/main_0053.c:50949-50966). When the result bit is set, this wrapper passes the loaded slot value to accepted prepare_or_wait_for_attribute_context_entry_processing; otherwise it skips the call. It returns zero either way. decompiled/main/main_0058.c:11114-11130. No indexed caller is available.
